summary.controlCheck: git -c core.whitespace=cr-at-eol diff --check exited 0 with zero output; command-local setting only, no config mutation.

causeAssessment: The errors are exclusively carriage returns at line endings, not content trailing spaces. Windows Path.write_text without newline emits CRLF and explains active build output behavior. Exact historic writer of the two Python source files and Bible/Book of Mormon page cannot be attributed from bytes alone. All seven also contain substantive approved-work differences from HEAD; do not restore them from HEAD.

currentWriters.finding: Both writes omit newline; this wrapper overwrites art-gallery, search index, and sitemap with Windows CRLF even though standalone gallery builder is already fixed.
Already supplies newline=LF for its own output; its source file itself currently has CRLF.
Standalone search output write omits newline.
Nested HTML write omits newline; untracked files are outside ordinary git diff --check.
Batch JSON writer omits newline; avoid normalizing existing immutable review or batch files.

safeNarrowFixProposal: Add explicit newline="\n" only to active mutable-output writers build_jesus_discovery.py, build_site_search.py, build_jesus_parent.py, and build_jesus_journey.py. Keep existing gallery newline setting. Consider mutable registry/assembler writer hardening separately; do not bulk-rewrite immutable batches/reviews or originals.

Normalize the seven diagnosed working files by byte replacement CRLF to LF, preserving every other byte and all substantive changes. Record pre/post normalized-content hashes to prove content equivalence. Do not use blanket strip/rstrip, git checkout/reset, or repository-wide normalization.

Rebuild only affected outputs using hardened writers, then run their existing --check/QA checks and quiet captured git diff --check. Separately scan newly added text files before staging because ordinary diff does not inspect untracked files.
Keep core.autocrlf=false; do not suppress whitespace checks globally or modify immutable review hashes to hide the issue.
limitations: No repository files mutated. Only work-directory diagnostic receipts were written.
No full minified lines were printed; captured diagnostic source lines were discarded.
No claim that substantive source changes are absent: normalized files differ from HEAD as expected.
